description: This file defines a Roslyn analyzer that enforces a rule that C# interface types implementing 'Orleans.Runtime.IAddressable' should not contain properties. It registers syntax node actions to analyze property declarations within interfaces and reports diagnostics if properties are found in such interfaces.

classes.name: GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer class that checks C# interface properties to ensure they do not contain properties when implementing 'Orleans.Runtime.IAddressable'.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analysis context, configuring code analysis and registering syntax node actions for property declarations.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Analyzes property declaration syntax nodes to determine if they violate the rule and reports diagnostics accordingly.
